task: A position with debt=8000 is under-collateralized. Max repay is half the debt (close factor 50 percent), and the liquidator earns a 5 percent penalty on what they repay. Compute max_repay + penalty (a single integer; repay=4000, penalty=200, total=4200). Store it as answer. When achieved, finish with rlm_set(~~QT~~Final~~QT~~, true).
lesson: Today I learned `floor` requires a non-zero argument, so `floor (* 8000 0)` incorrectly returned 0 instead of 4000.
